title: trifolium pannonicum subsp. elongatum
intro: Trifolium pannonicum subsp. elongatum, commonly known as Hungarian clover, is a subspecies of the Trifolium pannonicum plant, which is a species of clover. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. It is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various conditions including cardiovascular diseases and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Trifolium pannonicum subsp. elongatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
